content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Chattanooga

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your educational background, then document your relevant project experience. Granite PM Academy can guide you through eligibility verification before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Hours of Formal Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all required contact hours across our flexible schedule, designed to fit working professionals across Chattanooga's Advanced Manufacturing, Healthcare, Insurance, and Logistics sectors. Your instructor delivers real-world examples and interactive learning.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours with Granite PM Academy, submit your official PMI application with proof of education and experience. Pay the PMI exam fee through their portal. Allow time for PMI to review and approve your application before scheduling.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and instructor support—to reinforce core competencies. Schedule your PMP exam when ready. Test centers and virtual proctoring options are available; sit for the four-hour, multiple-choice examination.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs) through approved training, conferences, and practical project work. Renew with PMI before expiration to keep your credential active and your career competitive.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
